data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2020 the Syndicate's gross claims outstanding increased from GBP 798.7m to GBP 839.0m. The Syndicate reports an overall prioryear deterioration of GBP 6.8m for 2020 (a strengthening of reserves), driven primarily by natural catastrophe losses (notably US hurricane activity and prior years' hurricane and wildfire losses), COVID19 event cancellation claims (largely in the Contingency account), and adverse claims development on certain lines. Reinsurance arrangements and the ReinsurancetoClose of 2017 & prior materially affected the presentation of some liabilities.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken from Statement of Financial Position (claims outstanding 2019 comparative). Prioryear development (GBP 6.8m deterioration) is taken from the narrative in the claims development / risk note. A gross claims development triangle exists but contains an aggregated '2013 and prior' column and the printed table formatting in the source is difficult to parse precisely; therefore the PYD has been taken from the explicit narrative sentence. Some reserve/movement figures in the report are quoted net of reinsurance or relate to RITC transfers (2017 & prior) which distort direct triangle computations; where possible gross figures from balance sheet and segment tables were used.
